rules.publish_rate: PUBLISH_RATE requires: recall measured AND recall >= 0.9 AND precision_strict >= 0.9.
rules.publish_floor: PUBLISH_FLOOR requires: precision_strict >= 0.9 (a floor needs only precision).
rules.recall_not_run: Recall is NOT_RUN, forever: the 98 source_ref harvest documents are declared lost, so ask-level recall cannot be measured.
rules.read_discipline: A failed read is UNKNOWN, never PASS. A percentage is never emitted where a cell is not PASS.

cells.why: the 98 source_ref harvest documents are declared lost, so ask-level recall cannot be measured
strict precision is below the 0.9 floor, so no floor can be published
two independent labellers on all three sheets; non-ask bucket is only substantial, which is the weakest link, not a gate
the precision sample covers the register's origin links, ~99% phone channel; harness-channel citations were not sampled
